rules.rule: Read AGENTS.md and the confirmed requirement and acceptance records for this task. Review state transitions, idempotency, event ordering, crash/reconnect recovery, entity/artifact associations, and workdir/session/test-resource isolation. Record applicability, concrete evidence, and requirement gaps; do not invent product semantics. Inspect tests as well as implementation, callers and deletion effects. Check module boundaries, dependency direction, error handling, migration/compatibility, maintainability and confirmed extension needs; avoid speculative abstractions. Apply language/framework builtins only when they fit the actual project. Review requires an independent context; keep evidence and false-positive rationale. File coverage is not semantic or test coverage.
